text:
harper: dropping a compact-diff mock + a11y pass notes. main asks: where do we put the approve CTA in compact mode, how should selection summary behave for screen readers, and can we tighten the contrast on the failing badge? figma: https://redwood.design/s/compact-diff-mock (1/4)

eli: Nice! My vote is for moving the primary approve CTA to a floating action at bottom-right in compact lists. keeps header light. :+1:

toni: floating CTA feels fine visually but worried about keyboard users 449 focus order could jump to the floating CTA before they get to items. prefer a sticky footer that follows DOM order after the list.

harper: yeah sticky footer wins for keyboard predictability. also we need an 'undo' affordance after bulk approve 4a1 tiny toast with an undo link.

maya: copy suggestion for toast: "Approved 5 tests. Undo" — short and clear. Also change modal confirm verb from "Apply" to "Confirm approvals" to avoid ambiguity.

accessibility: A few a11y notes: failing badge doesn't meet 3:1 when used as status-only. try adding an icon + higher contrast color and a visible focus ring. For screen readers, the badge should include aria-describedby linking to the failing reason.

eli: On selection summary: instead of announcing count on every toggle (spam), expose a live region with aria-live="polite" that updates but only assertively announce when bulk action becomes enabled.

toni: Regarding diff expand: users expect the inline context to keep focus within the expanded panel. trap focus in the diff modal and provide keyboard shortcut 'Esc' to close and return focus to the previously focused test row.

harper: Good. Also propose small keyboard shortcuts: 'a' to approve selected, 'u' to unselect all, 'f' to open filters. We'll include these in the release notes.

accessibility: Make sure shortcuts are discoverable: add a small "Keyboard shortcuts" help link in the scorecard header that opens a quick cheat-sheet dialog. dialog must have aria-modal and focus trap.

eli: Visual nit: failing badge color + transparent outline looks too thin at 1px on 2x displays. use 2px or 0.125rem border for better visibility.

harper: Filter behavior: users asked for a "Show only new failures" toggle. We should add it to the quick filter chips and make it sticky per user. ticket: #UX-5409.

maya: Microcopy for the filter chip: "New failures" instead of "New" to be explicit. Also tooltip: "Only tests that transitioned to failing in this run."

toni: For mobile/compact parity: avoid hiding the filter drawer behind an overflow menu. show the three top filters (New failures, Unchecked, Flaky) inline, then 'More' opens the drawer.

eli: Scorecard sorting: current mock sorts by severity by default which hides some recent small regressions. can we add a secondary "Sort: Recent" option? default should be "Recent" for discovery.

harper: Agree default Recent. Add a small badge for "Severity" next to each test row for quick skim. badges must meet 4.5:1 when used as the only color cue.

accessibility: For screenreader summary when the run loads, announce "Eval run loaded: 12 tests, 3 failures, 2 flaky" using role=status polite. When a filter is applied, announce "Filter applied: New failures". Keep announcements short.

harper: One more UX question: when expanding a diff we show side-by-side and inline contexts. which should be default? Inline might be denser in compact mode.

maya: Default inline for compact; allow toggle to side-by-side. persist preference in local storage.

eli: dev-qa-bot: quick regression checklist created at https://jira.redwood/UX-5409; add visual test for floating vs sticky CTA at 320px and 768px.

toni: i'm going to draft an a11y checklist for the PR: focus order, aria-live regions, aria-describedby for failure reasons, contrast checks, keyboard shortcuts doc, undo toast with accessible label.

harper: thanks. if everyone signs off i'll update figma and open the PR with the checklist attached. lgtm from product.

accessibility: lgtm from a11y. please include NVDA and VoiceOver quick checks in the QA steps.

eli: lgtm.

dev-qa-bot: Reminder: include `yarn test:visual` and `yarn a11y:check` in CI for the branch.
